feedback: Weak match for DevOps Engineer role. Candidate is a Frontend Developer with 3 years experience, lacking the required 5+ years DevOps experience. Missing all core requirements: Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, cloud platforms (AWS/GCP), CI/CD pipelines, Python/Go scripting, monitoring tools, and Linux administration. Skills are primarily frontend-focused (React, Vue, CSS animations). Education level (Associate) below typical requirement for senior DevOps role.
